text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived for Symboli Kris S, 
so I handed it to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I have—truly received it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Having seen you run once, I was left in 
utter awe. Your physicality, technique, 
and spirit. Not to mention your solemn 
dignity on the track—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—I truly believe, presumptuous as it may 
be, that she will undoubtedly become a 
figure who sparks a revolution in Japan's 
racing world."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—They're placing their hopes... on me, 
aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ ――I must think――of a fitting 
reply.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I spent the whole night... 
drafting my reply.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Check—please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a solemn look, Symboli Kris S hands 
over a letter. Reading the contents—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"‘Thank you for your support. I am very, 
very happy. A heater has turned on in my 
heart.’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"If you keep watching over me, I'll feel 
even warmer. And I can work really, truly 
hard."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the Japanese racing 
world, I'll work hard and give it my all. 
I pinky promise right here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Such a dreadfully simple sentence made me 
imagine something weird for a second. I 
involuntarily look at Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I have always been poor at expressing 
myself. Even more so... in a foreign 
language."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So... I stripped away—all rhetoric. And 
wrote it—as simply as possible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Only for the BISHI-BASHI part— did I 
use—Japanese onomatopoeia— out of 
respect—for the culture, though."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ Will my feelings――reach them?
choice_data_list: I don't think that'll be a problem at all.

I don't think that'll be any problem at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. In that case—very well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ My true return gift――will 
have to wait a little longer, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Start a revolution—and fulfill—my 
mission. That—is the true—repayment."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words may have been simple, but her 
feelings burned hot. A new flame seemed to 
ignite in Symboli Kris S's heart toward 
fulfilling her mission.
